provenance.coverage_note: Regime boundaries are supported by CME notices. Annual holiday names are generated by the pinned rule set and every candidate day is additionally rejected if its source minutes do not exactly match the supported normal schedule. The calendar does not assert that an absent Databento minute is corrupt.
